cards.key_message: India is 20 days into the worst energy disruption in history with no end in sight.

data.title: India's Energy War
data.subtitle: No ceasefire. No playbook. No precedent.
data.source: EIA, S&P Global, India Petroleum Ministry

cards.key_message: In 20 days, this went from strikes to energy infrastructure war.

items.text: 900 strikes in 12 hours. Khamenei killed. Iran retaliates — 500+ missiles, 2,000 drones.
Traffic drops 70%. Maersk, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd suspend all transits.
Strait officially closed. Only Chinese vessels permitted passage.
Iran lays naval mines. US sinks 16 minelayers. 21 attacks on merchant ships.
First day of zero crossings. 850 tankers stranded globally.
Shah gas field + Fujairah hit. Larijani killed. Israel invades Lebanon.
South Pars struck. Iran hits Ras Laffan, Ras Tanura. Energy infrastructure war begins.
US bunker busters on Hormuz. Trump threatens to 'massively blow up' South Pars.

data.insight: Phase 1 closed the strait. Phase 2 is destroying the infrastructure behind it. Even when the strait reopens, the loading terminals need months of repair.

cards.key_message: 22 Indian ships carrying 1.7 million tonnes are stranded west of Hormuz.

data.title: 22 Ships. 1.7 Million Tonnes. Stuck.
data.subtitle: 611 crew members. 19 vessels west of Hormuz. 3 made it through — with Navy escort.
data.insight: Each transit is individually negotiated with Iran — no blanket deal. India MEA: 'Every ship movement is an individual happening.'

cards.key_message: India is fighting three crises at once — crude, cooking gas, and fertilizer — and most people only see the first one.

data.title: Crude. Cooking Gas. Fertilizer.
data.subtitle: Most people only see the first one.
data.insight: The crude crisis is on every front page. The LPG crisis is on every doorstep. The fertilizer crisis hasn't hit yet — but kharif planting is in 10 weeks.

cards.key_message: Even if shooting stops tomorrow, Hormuz doesn't reopen for months because of mines.

data.title: The Wrong Question Is "When Does the War End."
data.subtitle: The right question is "When are the mines cleared."

quote1.text: The terms aren't good enough yet.

quote2.text: We never asked for a ceasefire.

data.insight: Banks assume 3-6 weeks. Mine clearance alone is 51+ days — and the UK pulled its last Gulf minesweeper home before the war. Hormuz doesn't reopen until August at earliest.
data.source: CNN, Fortune, Foreign Affairs, Columbia University

cards.key_message: Four actions for the refinery CEO this week.

Model Nelson upgrade ROI at $120-150 Brent. Accelerate FCC/hydrocracker.

cards.key_message: Five actions for the CFO this week.

items.action: Model 3 scenarios: P&L, cash flow at $100, $146, $200.
Lock deferred crude at $69-75 (Dec 2026). Build hedge book.
Buy puts on Brent $100-105. Do NOT sell calls.
Board paper: every $10 = $14-16B. At $146, run rate $266B/yr.

data.title: India Refused the IEA. That's the Signal.
data.subtitle: Declined the largest coordinated release in IEA history. Declined G7. Hoarding every barrel.
data.insight: 74 days is not enough to be generous. The refusal to release is the strongest signal: the government expects this to last months.

cards.key_message: Frozen retail prices are bankrupting OMCs — the question is when, not whether, to release.

data.title: When Do You Break?

data.chart_title: OMC Cash Runway at Current Burn
data.insight: Release prices → inflation. Hold prices → insolvency. No painless option — only a choice of which pain.

data.subtitle: India's non-alignment got 3 ships through. China got 11. Japan got zero.
data.insight: China is the real winner. India's 70% non-Hormuz diversification — not diplomacy — is the real insurance.
